metadata.description: AI-powered secure development workflow for healthcare software. RePPITS methodology with HIPAA, SOC2, and HITRUST gates.

plugins.name: reppit-health
plugins.description: Run /reppit for the full Research → Propose → Plan → Implement → Test → Secure workflow with healthcare compliance gates, or invoke any phase as a standalone slash command. /reppit-goal runs a continuous goal-loop over an optimizable RICE-scored backlog. Adaptive risk-tiered gates, a bounded autonomous fix loop, resumable Tasks (/resume-reppit), parallel sub-issues, and opt-in headroom token compression. /secure runs HIPAA, SOC2, and HITRUST checklists against your diff and separates code-verifiable findings from organizational controls.
